== Biography ==
'''Malcolm, son of John de Glasgu''', received payment for a royal debt in a Scottish Exchequer account rendered at Perth on 26 March 1394.<ref>George Burnett, ed., [https://archive.org/details/rotuliscaccariir03grea ''The Exchequer Rolls of Scotland''], vol. 3 (Edinburgh, 1880), p. 342.</ref>

{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background-color:#E1F0B4;"
| '''Documented father:''' [[Space:John_de_Glasgu_(father_of_Malcolm)|John de Glasgu (fl. 1394)]]. The Exchequer entry directly calls Malcolm his son.
|-
| '''Possible son:''' [[Space:John_de_Glasgu_I'|John de Glasgu, Glasgow burgess (c.1425–after 1455)]]. Malcolm is the strongest preceding-generation candidate for the burgess, although no record names Malcolm's children.
|}

The Latin `Malcolmo filio Johannis de Glasgu` proves Malcolm's father was John and that John bore the Glasgow designation. It does not state that Malcolm himself used Glasgow as a byname or hereditary surname.

== Research Notes ==
The entry gives no occupation, mother, residence or further family. Malcolm should not be counted as a direct bearer of `de Glasgu` unless another record applies the name to him.
